verdict.rationale: Lambda documents direct SSH access to its On-Demand Cloud instances, which are Linux GPU-backed VMs. Strong control over the environment is implied by cloud-init launch-time configuration, alternate base images via the API, and a minimal GPU Base image billed as giving a high degree of control. A community tool also describes the workflow of launching an instance and SSHing in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing or registering your own SSH keys, explicit confirmation of root or sudo access, and independent hands-on corroboration of root-level control.
